title: An Investigation of Representation and Allocation Harms in Contrastive Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating representation and allocation harms caused by data underrepresentation using theoretical stochastic block models and controlled class subsampling on the CIFAR10 dataset to measure embedding collapse (via cosine distance) and downstream classification errors.

Analyzing the BiasInBios dataset to measure Gender Representation Harm (GRH) via the cosine distance between male and female biography embeddings across different occupations, and Gender Allocation Harm (GAH) by evaluating performance gaps and Equalized Odds violations in downstream occupation prediction.
